name: Feeding The Hungry
overview: Scripture teaches that showing mercy to the poor and feeding the hungry honors God and reflects a heart aligned with Him. Those who give generously to the needy are promised blessings and will not lack, while neglecting the hungry brings reproach and curse. Drawing out one’s soul to satisfy the afflicted brings spiritual light and favor. These verses emphasize that caring for the hungry is not only an act of compassion but also a direct expression of honoring the Creator.
